note: Pismo State Beach's northern campground: three paved loops on the flat back-dune between Hwy 1 and the beach, south of Pismo Beach town, with the Monarch Butterfly Grove beside it. The west-side sites back onto a restricted dune area that a foot trail crosses to the beach. A few back-in sites are about 24 ft. --Claude
summary: North Beach (Pismo SB): coastal dunes KEPT (official map: west sites back onto a 'Restricted Dune Area' with a Beach Foot Trail; hummocky foredune ridge on lidar; Hwy 1 to the east). $25 off-season / $35 May 15 - Sep 15; no hookups; max 36 ft; year-round; beach closures after the King Tide. Phone 805-489-1869 -> (805) 473-7220; drop the reservecalifornia website line.
flags: WATERFRONT: coastal dunes KEPT. The official North Beach map hatches a 'Restricted Dune Area (no vehicles)' between the west-side sites (7, 9, 11, 13, 14, 16, 18, 20, 22, 24, 25, 27) and the beach, crossed by the 'Beach Foot Trail' from beside site 14. Lidar hillshade shows a hummocky vegetated foredune ridge ~50-100 m wide (not a single berm) on that side, with a larger dune field to the SW; imagery has ~300 m of open beach beyond it. No highway, lot or day-use complex between: Hwy 1 and the Pismo Coast Village RV resort are east/north. West-loop sites at ~35.1310,-120.6355 (site 14 area) and ~35.1300,-120.6352 (sites 24-27).
